content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: ABIOC(MP-008 Identity Sign-In Anomaly on a Privileged Account) AND ABIOC(MP-008 Hands-on-Keyboard Endpoint Behavioral Deviation) AND XQL(MP-008 C2 Egress Session Burst From the Compromised Host) joined on the shared identity-host-session entity chain within a 300-second correlation window — fuses the ITDR sign-in anomaly, the EDR hands-on-keyboard behavioral deviation, and the NDR C2 egress into ONE incident_id spanning >= 3 planes (ITDR + EDR + NDR), producing the anomalous-auth -> interactive-shell-plus-discovery -> C2-egress causality chain.
rules.name: Identity-to-Endpoint-to-Network Hands-on-Keyboard Campaign Stitch
